title: pssc trace why --json
description: Where a register's last written value came from in a test trace: the write access, the statement that made it, and each value that statement read, followed back through the statements that wrote it (stmt events' defs/uses, debug images) to a register read, an import, a function call, an operation input or a component field's initial value. Fields not listed here may be added; readers ignore them.

index.description: The event's index (seq) in the trace.

text.description: The source line, when the file is found.

target.description: The write access: the last write to REG, or for REG.FIELD the last write that changed the field (else the last).

stmt.description: The statement that made the write; null when the trace has no stmt events (then note says why).

chain.description: Depth-first: each value read, and what gave it its value. Tokens: l:<local>, a#<arg>, f#<object field slot>, c:<component field path>.

kind.description: stmt: set by the statement at file:line; read: by a register read (reg, data); import: by an import's return (name, ret); call: by a function's return (fn, retval), followed into the function; input: no earlier statement of the frame set it (fn, args of the frame's call, when traced); initial: a component field not written in the trace.

depth.description: Hops from the target's statement (0 = a value it reads).

via.description: Index in chain of the entry whose statement reads this value; -1 = the target's statement.
